code:
from pyspark.sql.window import Window
from pyspark.sql.functions import row_number

vendor_window = (
  Window.partitionBy("VendorID").orderBy(col("fare_amount").desc())
)
caption: partitionBy() defines groups, orderBy() defines order within each -- like groupBy(), but keeps every row.
Numbers rows 1, 2, 3... per partition -- highest fare per VendorID gets rank 1.

dedup_window = Window.partitionBy(
  "VendorID", "tpep_pickup_datetime"
).orderBy(col("fare_amount").desc())

ranked = trips.withColumn("rn", row_number().over(dedup_window))
deduped = ranked.filter(col("rn") == 1).drop("rn")
caption: Rank duplicates by what should decide the winner, then keep only rn == 1.
